sourcePolicy: Other genre playlists, public full-song videos, current registered MP3 and matching trackKey/genre/EP; no re-upload from user. Recheck playlist membership and metadata each run. Aggregate playlists are not genre candidates.
relatedVideo: YouTube Studio native related-video field, pointing to the exact selected genre version.
deduplication: Current N80 tasks plus actual YouTube scheduled and published content; never create a second upload when an earlier result is ambiguous.
stateOwner: N80 Engine existing agent_movie job store
executor: N80 Auto registered ai.daily_shorts runner; persistent browser executor is not connected. Never present schedule registration as completed production.

mediaStorage.scope: Only registered generated media, encrypted before GitHub upload. Existing host originals and Gem knowledge remain authoritative.
mediaStorage.deleteScope: Only registered generated GitHub artifacts and generated local cache after verified publication; never originals.
mediaStorage.encryption: AES-256-GCM; per-asset key derived from existing N80 worker secret; never stored in artifact
mediaStorage.retentionNote: GitHub expires artifacts at 90 days; the authoritative host copy remains until verified publication cleanup.

creationWorkflow.sourceOfTruth: Current host trackKey/revision/audio hash, title, lyrics and genre image rules; existing character knowledge inside the Gem
creationWorkflow.githubSpecialist: Official Antigravity client using the GitHub repository and existing N80 MCP tools; external authentication and actual tool execution remain unverified. Retired personal Gemini CLI is disabled. Existing Gem and Flow require separate execution verification.
